benchmark.kind: cold end-to-end strict versus strict-disabled pairs

providers.install: Install a ttsc release that supports graph snapshot protocol v1. `ttsc@0.23.0` provides the ordinary `ttscserver` fallback but predates this strict protocol.
providers.resolution: Absolute `TTSC_GRAPH_BINARY`, target-project `ttsc` package/binary, target-project `.bin`, then PATH/global compatibility fallback.
providers.requirements: A matching ttsc/TypeScript project and tsconfig/jsconfig/package inputs.
providers.mode: resident-no-op-reuse; invalidated-closure shard deltas with a compatible producer
providers.nativeAnalysis: A compatible target-project ttsc checker owns one resident compiler process and its incremental semantic state.
providers.exportMerge: Changed compiler-owned raw shards cross a versioned transaction; the client validates the complete manifest and adapts only upserts before atomic publication.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged requests reuse the exact snapshot; body edits reuse unaffected native and normalized shards, while build-universe changes reload safely.
providers.limitations: No compatible ttsc release is published yet. Version 0.23.0 returns a legacy complete dump and therefore falls back honestly until the native shard producer ships.
providers.decline: A missing target-project ttsc binary, legacy full-dump producer, incompatible request cap, malformed transaction or unsupported schema declines the strict provider.

providers.install: Go 1.25+; the package ships the Go exporter source. Install corroboration with `go install github.com/scip-code/scip-go/cmd/scip-go@v0.2.7`.
providers.resolution: Project/PATH `samchon-graph-go`, then the shipped source runner through Go; absolute environment overrides take precedence.
providers.requirements: Go workspace/module inputs, selected GOOS/GOARCH/cgo environment, embedded files and vendored inputs.
providers.nativeAnalysis: The shipped exporter runs one compiler-owned go/packages batch against the selected build universe.
providers.exportMerge: A changed-input batch emits and validates one whole-workspace graph before snapshot publication.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; no resident go/packages checker survives changed builds.
providers.limitations: Current changed-input export is a full rebuild and does not retain a resident `go/packages` checker session.
providers.decline: A missing Go 1.25+ toolchain, missing pinned scip-go corroborator or invalid workspace/module load declines the strict provider.

providers.resolution: Absolute `SAMCHON_GRAPH_LUA`, then project/PATH LuaLS; the shipped exporter may be replaced by `SAMCHON_GRAPH_LUA_EXPORTER`.
providers.requirements: LuaLS workspace configuration and the shipped readable exporter.
providers.nativeAnalysis: LuaLS analyzes the workspace and the shipped exporter asks its semantic VM for declaration references.
providers.exportMerge: A changed-input run publishes one references-only whole-workspace graph.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; the current exporter is not a resident incremental session.
providers.limitations: The current exporter calls `vm.getRefs` per declaration and proves references only; #83 replaces it with an occurrence-oriented resident traversal.
providers.decline: A missing LuaLS binary/exporter, invalid workspace result or bounded request declines the strict provider.

providers.install: Build the `samchon/rust-analyzer` graph-snapshot fork at commit `2850ecba80311bebd4cdaa9fedc5321533b5b1e7`; point `SAMCHON_GRAPH_RUST_ANALYZER_HIR` at that binary or install it as `samchon-rust-analyzer`.
providers.resolution: Absolute `SAMCHON_GRAPH_RUST_ANALYZER_HIR`, then project/PATH `samchon-rust-analyzer`, then a project/PATH `rust-analyzer` only when its version reports the pinned producer commit.
providers.requirements: Cargo metadata/config, lock/toolchain inputs, target/features/cfg and build-script/proc-macro universe.
providers.mode: resident-no-op-reuse; invalidated-closure shard deltas; validated restart checkpoints
providers.nativeAnalysis: The pinned rust-analyzer fork owns one resident HIR database and exports declarations, semantic relationships, diagnostics, coverage and unresolved boundaries from that exact analysis revision.
providers.exportMerge: Content-addressed source shards cross a versioned LSP transaction; the client verifies producer identity, universe, complete manifests, shard digests and graph invariants before atomic publication.
providers.reuseResident: No-op requests reuse the resident snapshot; interface changes invalidate dependent shards, while a complete consumer checkpoint restores the same generation after process restart.
providers.limitations: The producer is currently available from the draft fork PR rather than a rust-analyzer release, and Rust has no `renders` relationship family.
providers.decline: A missing pinned producer, incompatible commit/schema, malformed transaction, invalid checkpoint, unsupported bounded option or failed Cargo workspace load declines this route.

providers.install: Build the `samchon/llvm-project` graph-snapshot fork at commit `ae904413566b54aca08e46ebee1769c110601e6b`; point `SAMCHON_GRAPH_CLANGD_SNAPSHOT` at `clangd` or install it as `samchon-clangd`, and provide a compilation database.
providers.resolution: Absolute `SAMCHON_GRAPH_CLANGD_SNAPSHOT`, then project/PATH `samchon-clangd`, then a project/PATH `clangd` only when its version reports the pinned producer commit.
providers.requirements: A valid compilation database plus every source, header, generated input, command, target and working-directory identity used by its translation units.
providers.mode: resident-no-op-reuse; complete changed-TU/configuration replacement; content-addressed deltas
providers.nativeAnalysis: The pinned clangd fork runs every registered command, keeps headers scoped by translation unit and configuration, and captures complete Clang roles, relations, macros, includes, diagnostics and source digests from the same compiler pass.
providers.exportMerge: Versioned native shards cross one optimistic atomic snapshot; the client verifies producer identity, complete manifests, native and common shard digests, coverage, unresolved boundaries and source identities before publication.
providers.reuseResident: No-op requests reuse the exact resident graph; changed sources or compilation-database commands reindex their owning translation units while a failed batch preserves the last complete generation without publishing it as current.
providers.limitations: Calls, instantiation, exports, implements and dispatch are explicitly partial; C/C++ have no decorates, renders or tests family, and the producer is currently a draft fork rather than an LLVM release.
providers.decline: A missing pinned producer, missing or invalid compilation database, incompatible schema/commit, incomplete indexing batch, source/configuration movement or compiler error declines this route.

providers.install: Install `scip-java` 0.13.1, the `scip` decoder and a compatible JDK; Kotlin experiments pin a compatible source build.
providers.resolution: Project-local producer/decoder/JDK precede PATH; absolute environment overrides select each tool.
providers.requirements: Maven or Gradle project metadata, dependency/classpath state and Java/Kotlin compiler inputs.
providers.nativeAnalysis: scip-java drives the selected Maven or Gradle build and its Java/Kotlin producers as one batch.
providers.exportMerge: The complete decoded artifact is merged as a contains/references graph before atomic publication.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; no javac, kotlinc or build session remains resident.
providers.limitations: The released Gradle path disables configuration cache and runs `clean scipCompileAll`; it is navigation fallback for #74/#76, not compiler-owned calls or accesses.
providers.decline: A missing producer/decoder/JDK, unsupported Maven or Gradle project, or invalid dependency/build configuration declines the strict provider.

providers.install: `dotnet tool install --global scip-dotnet`; install the `scip` decoder and matching .NET SDK.
providers.resolution: Project-local producer/decoder/toolchain precede PATH; absolute environment overrides select each tool.
providers.requirements: Solution/project/TFM/NuGet/MSBuild inputs and a resolvable SDK.
providers.nativeAnalysis: scip-dotnet loads and analyzes the selected solution through one batch producer run.
providers.exportMerge: The complete decoded artifact publishes declarations but no currently defensible edge family.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; no Roslyn workspace remains resident.
providers.limitations: The artifact proves declarations but no graph edge family and can log MSBuildWorkspace failures after publishing.
providers.decline: A missing producer/decoder/.NET SDK, absent solution/project input or invalid MSBuild load declines the strict provider.

providers.install: `npm install -g @sourcegraph/scip-python@0.6.6`; install the `scip` decoder and select Python.
providers.resolution: Project-local producer/decoder/interpreter precede PATH; Python aliases are tried in order and absolute overrides select each tool.
providers.nativeAnalysis: scip-python runs its bundled Pyright-based analysis once for the selected project environment.
providers.exportMerge: The complete decoded artifact publishes a references-only project graph.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; no Pyright analysis session remains resident.
providers.limitations: The bundled historical Pyright core proves references only and can recover from malformed pyproject configuration with defaults.
providers.decline: A missing producer/decoder/Python interpreter, absent project input or unusable Python environment declines the strict provider.

providers.install: Install the pinned `scip-ruby` 0.4.7 release binary, the `scip` decoder and matching Ruby/Bundler.
providers.resolution: Project-local producer/decoder/Ruby precede PATH; absolute environment overrides select each tool.
providers.nativeAnalysis: scip-ruby performs one full-project batch using the selected Ruby, Bundler and Sorbet inputs.
providers.exportMerge: The complete decoded artifact publishes declarations but no currently defensible edge family.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; no Ruby or Sorbet index remains resident.
providers.limitations: The current artifact proves no graph edge family; it does not expose structural coverage, Sorbet sigils or typed unresolved sites.
providers.decline: A missing producer/decoder/Ruby runtime, unusable Bundler environment or invalid project configuration declines the strict provider.

providers.install: `dart pub global activate scip_dart 1.6.2`; install the `scip` decoder and Dart SDK.
providers.resolution: Project-local producer/decoder/Dart precede PATH; absolute environment overrides select each tool.
providers.requirements: pubspec/lock, analysis options and resolved package configuration.
providers.nativeAnalysis: scip_dart performs one full-project batch using the resolved Dart package universe.
providers.exportMerge: The complete decoded artifact publishes declarations but no currently defensible edge family.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; this is not resident Analysis Server state.
providers.limitations: The current artifact proves no graph edge family and is not resident Analysis Server state.
providers.decline: A missing producer/decoder/Dart SDK, absent package configuration or failed pub resolution declines the strict provider.

providers.install: Install the project-local scip-php dependency with Composer, expose `vendor/bin/scip-php`, and install the `scip` decoder.
providers.resolution: Project `vendor/bin` precedes PATH; absolute producer/decoder/PHP overrides select each tool.
providers.requirements: Composer manifest/lock/autoload and PHP/PHPStan configuration inputs.
providers.nativeAnalysis: The project-local scip-php producer performs one full-project batch through Composer/PHP inputs.
providers.exportMerge: The complete decoded artifact publishes declarations but no currently defensible edge family.
providers.reuseResident: Unchanged inputs reuse the validated snapshot; no PHPStan or Composer analysis session remains resident.
providers.limitations: The current raw parser/Composer artifact proves no graph edge family and has no diagnostic or role grounding.
providers.decline: A missing project-local producer/decoder/PHP runtime, absent Composer autoload or invalid project configuration declines the strict provider.
